team-builder.all-1: You move fast and expect the same from the people around you. You make calls quickly, pivot without hesitation, and stay plugged into what your team is doing throughout the day. You lead with confidence and don't overthink. You'll match best with self-starting, fast-moving Independents who can keep up with your pace.
team-builder.all-2: You balance speed with context before making calls. You check in before committing, adapt once you understand why something changed, and keep a steady daily rhythm. You share your thinking and give people room to challenge it. You'll match best with communicative, reliable Independents who can think on their feet.
team-builder.all-3: You value consistency and like to protect the plan. You review the details before signing off, push back when the scope shifts, and plan your week in advance. You look for compromises and trust your team to run between weekly check-ins. You'll match best with dependable Independents who value structure and follow through.
team-builder.all-4: You take time to get things right before moving forward. You wait for the full picture, go deep on one project at a time, and give your team full autonomy. You're happy to let the best idea win and only check in when there's something real to discuss. You'll match best with detail-oriented Independents who take care and deliver polished work.
team-builder.mostly-1-2: You make decisions quickly and pivot without drama. You stay responsive and keep a pulse on your team, but you also make room for their input. You lead with confidence while staying open to being wrong. You'll match best with self-starting Independents who communicate well and can keep pace.
team-builder.mostly-2-1: You move at a good pace but always want context before committing. You make the call when you need to, but you prefer to understand why before changing direction. You keep a daily rhythm with your team and give them room to speak up. You'll match best with communicative Independents who can balance speed with quality.
team-builder.mostly-2-3: You plan ahead and check in with intention. You consult your team before big calls, adapt strategically when things shift, and look for compromises when there's friction. You trust your team between weekly syncs but stay accessible when they need you. You'll match best with reliable Independents who value structure and clear communication.
team-builder.mostly-3-2: You review the details and plan with purpose. You adapt when the reasoning is clear, batch your communications, and look for the middle ground when there's pushback. You check in daily but give your team room to work. You'll match best with dependable Independents who bring structure and keep things transparent.
team-builder.mostly-3-4: You review the details and protect the plan. You go deep on one project at a time, push back on unnecessary changes, and look for solutions that keep everyone aligned. You check in weekly and let your team work without interruption. You'll match best with focused, structured Independents who take ownership and deliver consistently.
team-builder.mostly-4-3: You wait for clarity before acting. You go deep, let your team take the lead on ideas, and batch your replies so you can focus. You check in weekly with a clear agenda and give your team space to do their best work. You'll match best with self-directed, detail-oriented Independents who can manage their own time and deliver quality.
team-builder.mixed: You've got a balanced approach, adapting your style based on the situation. You make fast calls when needed but take a strategic approach when things shift. You plan your week with intention and look for compromises when there's pushback. You'll match best with versatile Independents who can adapt to different working styles.

independent.all-1: You move fast, take initiative, and figure things out on your own. You pivot quickly when things change, juggle multiple tasks at once, and always reply right away. You back your work and aren't afraid to push back. You'll match best with Team Builders and teams that trust you to run with minimal direction and deliver.
independent.all-2: You stay on top of things without needing to be managed. You loop people in before making calls, ask the right questions when things change, and prioritize by deadline. You're responsive and easy to work with. You'll match best with Team Builders and teams that value communication and give you room to do your thing.
independent.all-3: You value clarity, structure, and doing things the right way. You think things through before committing, flag scope changes, and plan your week in advance. You share a clean weekly summary and look for solutions that work for both sides. You'll match best with Team Builders and teams that set clear expectations and respect your process.
independent.all-4: You take time, ask questions, and deliver polished work. You pause for clarity, go deep on one thing at a time, and share updates when there's real progress. You trust your Team Builder's judgment and keep communication to scheduled check-ins. You'll match best with Team Builders and teams that appreciate thorough, high-quality work over speed.
independent.mostly-1-2: You take initiative and adapt on the fly. You don't wait for permission, but you keep your Team Builder in the loop throughout the day. You're open to feedback and easy to collaborate with. You'll match best with Team Builders and teams that trust you to run but appreciate being kept in the loop.
independent.mostly-2-1: You take initiative when it counts but ask the right questions before changing direction. You'll match best with Team Builders and teams that value communication and give you room to do your thing.
independent.mostly-2-3: You plan ahead and communicate consistently. You loop people in before making decisions, adapt with questions first, and plan your week in advance. You find the version that works for everyone and send a daily update to keep things clear. You'll match best with Team Builders and teams that set expectations clearly and respect your process.
independent.mostly-3-2: You think before acting and communicate with consistency. You'll match best with Team Builders and teams that value transparency and dependable delivery.
independent.mostly-3-4: You think things through and deliver polished work. You lay out your options before committing, flag scope changes, and block out distractions to go deep. independent.mostly-4-3: You take time to get it right. You pause for clarity, go deep on one task at a time, and share a weekly summary of what's done. You take initiative when there's a blocker, ask the right questions when things change, and plan your week with intention. You're easy to work with and keep your Team Builder updated daily.
